yard.text: Hides are stretched on frames across the yard, some of them from animals that shouldn't exist. {{tanner_name}} works a scraper over something with too many legs' worth of fur and doesn't look up.

the_pelts.text: 'Irradiated fur, cured slow and lined tight,' {{tanner_name}} says, tossing you a cape that still smells faintly of ozone. 'Warm. Glows a little in the dark. That's normal, probably.'

choices.label: Ask about the workbench with the melted tools.

the_workbench.text: 'Corrosive syrup, if you're patient,' {{tanner_name}} says, dipping a blade edge into a jar that hisses. 'Eats through anything soft. Keep it away from your gloves. And your face.'

flesh_fly.text: Something with too many wings lands on you before you can swat it away.

syrup_splash.text: A jar tips. The syrup finds skin before you can move.
